representation.state_reconstruction: Each state overlays fixed_state_fields. code_ref resolves exactly one immutable source record by case_id/input_sha256; no other state field is omitted. Frame array is top-first; fold right using uiFrame(frame,rest), ending uiNoFrames(). Environment_k is a K Map; whitespace juxtaposes distinct entries. Map order has no semantic meaning. Pure function subterms are normalized within their charged rule; this does not create another A fuel event.
representation.edges: State i is the full pre-state for the next edge and full post-state of the preceding edge. via_rule_start_line identifies the rule taking i-1 to i in pinned main.k; startup/publication are separate zero-charge edges.
representation.ordinary_prefix_reconstruction: For each five-element literal prefix row, boundary state fields come from states[boundary_state_index], replacing initial_fuel and remaining_fuel by the literal row values; consumed_work equals boundary_state_index. The complete charged sequence is states[0..boundary_state_index] with initial_fuel from the row and remaining_fuel=initial_fuel-charged_steps. Code/env/frames/depth/control/output are otherwise unchanged. Publication replaces control_k by .K and output_k by published_output_k, preserving every other boundary field. These are ordinary finite-budget prefixes of valid programs. No attempted-work diagnostic is defined by K A.
representation.helper_charge: unmetered in A; helper visits/work not measured and never filled with zero
representation.prefix_extent: Every integer initial fuel from zero through exact completion fuel plus one is explicitly listed for every case. For any larger budget the same terminal state is reached after the listed exact completion count, with the surplus remaining; no further charges occur.
